# Appeal of Denial — Partial Knee Replacement (CPT 27446)

**Re: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated 2026-08-09**
**Member: Riley Grant | Member ID: W485404613**
**Reference Number: POC-5767D9118E-71989**
**Governing Policy: EVH CG 2734.CC Outpatient Major Joint Arthroplasty (Hips and Knees)** ([link](https://countycare.com/wp-content/uploads/ECG_2734.CC-for-Outpatient-Major-Joint-Arthroplasy-Hips-and-Knees-ver-Dec-25.pdf))

Dear CountyCare Appeals Department,

I am writing to request reconsideration of the denial of my prior authorization request for a partial knee replacement (CPT 27446), which was denied on 2026-08-09 under reference number POC-5767D9118E-71989. My surgeon, Dr. Marchetti, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I believe the medical records support approval under the plan's own criteria.

## Why I believe the denial should be reversed

The denial states that "the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure." I would like to walk through what the plan's own policy, EVH CG 2734.CC, actually asks for, and show how my records meet it.

The policy states:

> "Replacement/revision of previous arthroplasty Replacement/revision TKA or THA may be considered necessary as an inpatient procedure when the following criteria are met:"

and lists:

> "● Effusions ● Acute fracture ● Avascular necrosis ● Joint space narrowing or large osteophytes on imaging ● Severe sclerosis or deformity ● Bone on bone contact WITH At least 12 weeks of non-surgical treatment documented in the medical record (6,16,17):"

My MRI from 2026-05-30 documents full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial compartment with **bone-on-bone apposition**, and a **Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4** rating medially. This directly matches the "bone on bone contact" finding named in the policy's own list.

On the non-surgical treatment requirement, my records show:
- NSAID use for **8 months** (well over 12 weeks) with inadequate relief;
- A corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-19, which gave only 4 weeks of partial relief;
- Supervised physical therapy for 8 weeks (2026-05-15 to 2026-07-10), 18 visits, documented in my physical therapy discharge note.

Taken together, this is more than 12 weeks of documented non-surgical treatment, as the policy requires.

I would also note that the specific criteria quoted above appear under a heading for "Replacement/revision of previous arthroplasty" performed as an inpatient procedure. My surgery is a first-time partial knee replacement, not a revision of a prior arthroplasty. If different or additional criteria govern a first-time outpatient partial knee replacement, I have not been shown them, and I am asking that they be provided so I can address them directly.

## Request for the criteria applied

I understand that CountyCare may use InterQual criteria, which is licensed software rather than a publicly posted document. I am nonetheless entitled to see it. Under ERISA and ACA appeal regulations, the plan must provide me, free of charge, the specific rule or criterion relied on in my denial. I am formally requesting, in writing, **the InterQual subset, edition, and full criteria text applied to my determination.**

## My other clinical findings

For completeness, I also want to note the following, all documented in my records:
- 9 months of progressive knee pain, unrelieved by rest;
- Inability to climb stairs without assistance;
- Waking 3–4 times nightly due to pain;
- Positive provocative testing on exam, with range of motion limited by pain;
- No active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, non-smoker.

## Closing request

I am asking CountyCare to reconsider this denial in light of my surgeon's documentation and the records described above, and to approve the requested partial knee replacement (CPT 27446). I understand my appeal must be received by **2027-02-05**. Please send your response, and any additional information about where to file this appeal, to the address printed on my denial letter, or I will confirm the correct address by calling the number on the back of my insurance card.

Please let me know if any additional information is needed from me or from Dr. Marchetti's office.

Thank you for your time and reconsideration.

Sincerely,

________________________
Riley Grant
Member ID: W485404613
[Address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
Date: [Date of submission]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
